name: single-leg-valslide-leg-curl
instructions:
1. Set up in a supine position with your hands by your sides, knees bent, and one foot placed on a valslide.
2. Pull one hip into flexion with the knee bent and maintain that position.
3. Extend your hips by contracting the glute of the plant leg and then slowly extend your leg until it’s almost parallel to the floor.
4. Contract your hamstrings to pull your heel towards your butt.
5. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
starting_position: 1. Set up in a supine position with your hands by your sides, knees bent, and one foot placed on a valslide. 2. Pull one hip into flexion with the knee bent and maintain that position.
